research.summary: cPanel & WHM is a commercial Linux server automation and hosting management platform. The vendor documents current version lifecycle dates on a knowledge-base page; an optional deterministic TIERS.json feed provides LTS expiry timestamps, but only for LTS branches.
research.notes: The cPanel documentation page states "Approximate Release Date" and "Approximate End of Life Date" with month-precision values (e.g. 'March 2023', 'December 2026'). These are month-precision and stored as YYYY-MM without padding to a day, per AGENTS.md rule 4. The docs page only shows the four most recent release versions (110 LTS, 134 LTS, 136, 138); older versions' EOL dates are not on this page. A deterministic TSERS.json feed (https://httpupdate.cpanel.net/cpanelsync/TIERS.json) provides exact LTS expiry timestamps as Unix epoch values, but implementing a deterministic collector is a future enhancement; this contribution uses the docs page as the primary evidence source. Month-precision dates exclude these releases from the day-precision OpenEoX export, where they are enumerated under v1/openeox/index.json exclusions.
